title: Integrity Bossfight Spawner
description: Makes Integrity from The Broken Script spawn on a custom day!
body:
**_YOU MUST HAVE THE BROKEN SCRIPT 1.20.1 INSTALLED FOR THIS MOD TO WORK. You can install The Broken Script 1.20.1 here: (I recommend using RUS patch)_**  https://tbsarchive.org/
 



**This mod allows Integrity WIP Bossfight from The Broken Script mod to spawn automatically in your world on a customized day (Default day is 66)**

**This mod is highly customizable as you can choose the day Integrity spawns and decide whether it bans you upon death.**

**_INSTALL CONFIGURED TO CONFIGURATE THE MOD:_**

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/configured



**_Mod Configuration:_**

**SPAWN DAY: Here you can modify when Integrity will spawn in your world**

**DEFAULT DAY: 66 (RANGE 1-666)**

![DAY CONFIG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e542a4a9d3520f0b140410b402f0dbcdeacb872a.png)



**BAN: You can choose whether you want to be banned from your world if Integrity kills your or not.**

**DEFAULT: TRUE** 

![BAN CONFIG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01c937454f3ccdbbc12db27edc9322a25b6c237d.png)
